about: Owner decisions for docs/DMF-UI-REACT-PARITY.json (M17). Keys are item ids from that record (a trailing * covers a prefix). A decision that matches no difference fails `npm run react:check`.

button.props.Button.type: Native button type. The adapter defaults it to button so a Button outside a form never submits; shadcn's Base UI button sets the same default.

input.props.Input.type: Native input type, passed through to the element as a native attribute.

card.props.CardTitle.as: Renders the title as a heading level or other element, as DMF UI's Astro CardTitle does (see the Astro record).

badge.slots:badge: DMF UI's React Badge marks its element with data-slot=badge; shadcn's Badge also sets data-slot=badge, so this is the same name under the React adapter's data-slot. Kept as extra for the adapter's own naming.

alert.props.Alert.role: Defaults to role=note so an alert with no live region is still announced as a note; shadcn's Alert has no role of its own.

separator.props.Separator.decorative: Chooses between role=separator and a presentational divider, as DMF UI's Astro Separator does.

field.slots:field-title: The React adapter's name for the field title, as its FieldLabel is a label. shadcn's FieldTitle uses field-label.
field.props.Field.role: Defaults to role=group so a field's controls are grouped for assistive technology; shadcn's Field has no role of its own.
field.props.FieldError.role: Defaults to role=alert so errors are announced when they appear; shadcn's FieldError has no role of its own.
field.slots:field-separator-content: The text inside a separator with a label. The adapter renders the separator text in the separator element itself.

checkbox.slots:checkbox-indicator: The checkbox is a native input styled with its own pseudo-element, so there is no indicator element (as in the Astro record).

radio-group.slots:radio-group-indicator: The radio is a native input styled with its own pseudo-element, so there is no indicator element (as in the Astro record).
radio-group.props.RadioGroup.defaultValue: Initial value, uncontrolled, as native radios use.
radio-group.props.RadioGroup.disabled: Disables every item in the group.
radio-group.props.RadioGroup.name: Native name that submits with the form.
radio-group.props.RadioGroup.onValueChange: Callback for the selected value; React's form for change handling.
radio-group.props.RadioGroup.orientation: Lays the items out in a row or column, styled through data-orientation.
radio-group.props.RadioGroup.required: Native required on the group's radios.
radio-group.props.RadioGroup.value: Controlled value, the React form of the same selection.
radio-group.props.RadioGroupItem.onChange: React change handler for the item's native input.
radio-group.props.RadioGroupItem.value: The native value this item submits.

select.parts:SelectOption: The React Select is a native select, so its options are native option elements.
